name: Katong & Joo Chiat
summary: Peranakan shophouses, food streets, and character housing with east-side energy — walkable strips inland from East Coast.
body: Katong and Joo Chiat sit just inland from East Coast with denser street life — kaya toast, heritage façades, and evening footfall on Joo Chiat Road. Conservation shophouses and boutique apartments attract people who want texture over tower amenities. Parking, stairs, noise, and humidity in older stock are real; budget aircon servicing and pest vigilance like any tropical walk-up. The trade is neighbourhood personality you cannot get in a new CBD condo, with Marine Parade / Dakota / Paya Lebar MRT options depending on pocket. Pairs well with East Coast living guides for families who want food culture without full heartland anonymity.
commuteNotes: Dakota / Paya Lebar / Marine Parade MRT options depending on pocket; East Coast Park is a short hop.
